scope_replacement.old: Do not transfer a fact about another entity or a different comparison to the Original question.
scope_replacement.new: Use the Original question to set the answer target and conditions; do not inherit extra restrictions or an intermediate answer target from auxiliary questions.

design_interpretation.r04: One instruction replacement for answer target/conditions; no new factual information.
design_interpretation.s04: Interaction of that replacement and frozen e03 evidence addition; not a single-factor improvement over p02.
design_interpretation.risk: Extra restrictions may be interpreted too broadly; valid bridge-derived constraints must still be kept. Prompt wording alone does not verify scope.

cross_arm_cache_requirement: When the whole final payload is identical, reuse one first successful receipt; do not pay twice for the86 duplicate-only cases.
reference_boundary: No fresh90/confirmation outcomes, reference answers or qrels opened; chooser is the unchanged round3 rank/doc_id rule.
